# اِجْتَزْتِ (ijtazti) /id͡ʒ.taz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَازَ (ijtāza)
# اُجْتِزْتُ (ujtiztu) /ud͡ʒ.tiz.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِج
